system.description:
Deal [2D + (Attack Power)]  Physical or Magical Damage (you select). If you do not have an enemy other than the target in the same Sq as you, target also recieves [Pursuit: [DEX mod] × SR].

A special skill that creates magical blades from weapons and hands, slashing enemies to pieces in a single flash. The color and shape of the blade vary slightly depending on the user's preference.
